actions.copyVenueHint: Send this link to the venue — they scan and check guests in without an account
actions.copyClientHint: Send this link to the client — they follow replies and attendance without an account

import.title: Import the guest list from a CSV or Excel file
import.help: The file needs a name column. Optional columns: phone, group, number of companions, notes. A guest with the same phone number is updated instead of duplicated.
import.noRows: No rows could be read from the file.

qr.heading: QR codes — {{title}}
qr.hint: Each card carries a guest's code. The guest scans it with their camera to open their invitation, and reception scans it at the door to check them in. Cut the cards and hand them out, or send each guest their link on WhatsApp from the guests page.
qr.empty: No guests. Add guests or import a CSV file first.

scan.idleVenue: Press “Start camera” and point it at a guest's code
scan.manual: Or paste the guest code / link here
scan.manualVenue: Or type the pass code (like FRH-XXXXXX)
scan.resultHint: The result will appear here after each scan.

support.ready: Point the camera at the guest's code — registration happens automatically.
support.noCamera: This browser doesn't allow camera access. Open the link in Safari or Chrome, or type the code in the box below.
support.jsqrFailed: The code reader couldn't be loaded. Check your connection, or type the code in the box below.
support.denied: Camera permission is off. On iPhone: Settings → Safari → Camera → Allow, then reload the page.
support.notFound: No camera is available on this device.
support.busy: The camera is busy or unavailable right now. Close any other app using it and try again.

scan.noPass: This guest has no entry pass — they haven't confirmed attendance.
scan.notOurGuest: This code isn't one of this invitation's guests.

venue.empty: No guests registered for this invitation yet.
venue.foot: This page refreshes by itself — leave it open at the door.
venue.noPass: This guest has no entry pass.

client.subtitle: This is your page for following the invitation — every reply and message that reaches you shows up here as it happens.
client.emptyText: Add RSVP, QR or well-wishes to the invitation and they'll appear here.

pass.download: Download the code as an image
pass.hintUsed: This pass has been fully used.
pass.hintNone: No entry pass — confirm your attendance from the invitation first.
pass.hintActive: Show this code at the door. Good for {{n}} {{people}}.
